title: Assemble plugin editor with four page navigation
description:
Rewrite Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp to assemble the four-page GUI, and register all new GUI and Telemetry sources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the sole owner of PluginEditor.* and CMakeLists.txt in phase j.

Editor requirements:
- `class ShredSpaceAudioProcessorEditor : public juce::AudioProcessorEditor` (keep the existing class name found in the file) holding a single `CustomLookAndFeel` instance, applied via `setLookAndFeel(&lookAndFeel)` in the constructor and cleared with `setLookAndFeel(nullptr)` in the destructor — the destructor call is mandatory to avoid a dangling LookAndFeel pointer.
- Owned page instances: PerformancePage, VoicesPage, ToneMotionPage, IntelligencePage, each `std::unique_ptr` and only one visible at a time.
- A navigation bar of four `juce::TextButton` tabs (Performance, Voices, Tone & Motion, Intelligence) that switch the visible page via `setVisible`.
- `setResizable(true, true)` with a sensible minimum size via `setResizeLimits`, an initial `setSize`, and a `resized()` that lays out the nav bar and gives the remaining bounds to the active page. No hard-coded absolute child positions that break on resize.
- The editor performs no audio processing and reads audio-derived data only through the processor's TelemetryState accessor.

CMakeLists.txt: add Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.cpp, Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp, Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp, Source/GUI/PerformancePage.cpp, Source/GUI/VoicesPage.cpp, Source/GUI/ToneMotionPage.cpp, Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.cpp, and Source/GUI/DetectorDisplay.cpp to the existing plugin target's sources using the existing `target_sources` pattern. Do not change the product identity values (ShredSpace, nSpace Systems, 1.0.0, NSPC, ShSp, com.nspacesystems.shredspace, urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace), the target list, the JUCE submodule reference, or the presets. Do not add any third-party dependency.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt (existing target name, target_sources block, juce_add_plugin arguments)
- Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp (existing class name and constructor signature)
- Source/GUI/PerformancePage.h, VoicesPage.h, ToneMotionPage.h, IntelligencePage.h (constructor signatures produced by j.4–j.7)
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h and Source/PluginProcessor.h

After editing, build and confirm the Linux VST3, LV2, and Standalone targets compile and link.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginEditor.h declares owned std::unique_ptr members for PerformancePage, VoicesPage, ToneMotionPage, and IntelligencePage and a CustomLookAndFeel member
Source/PluginEditor.cpp calls setLookAndFeel(&lookAndFeel) in the constructor and setLookAndFeel(nullptr) in the destructor
Source/PluginEditor.cpp creates four navigation buttons that switch exactly one visible page at a time and calls setResizable(true, true) with resize limits
Source/PluginEditor.cpp resized() lays out the navigation bar and assigns the remaining bounds to the active page

CMakeLists.txt lists Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.cpp, Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp, Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp, Source/GUI/PerformancePage.cpp, Source/GUI/VoicesPage.cpp, Source/GUI/ToneMotionPage.cpp, Source/GUI/IntelligencePage.cpp, and Source/GUI/DetectorDisplay.cpp in the plugin target sources

CMakeLists.txt still declares product name ShredSpace, company nSpace Systems, version 1.0.0, manufacturer code NSPC, plugin code ShSp, bundle id com.nspacesystems.shredspace, and LV2 URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace, with the VST3, LV2, and Standalone formats unchanged
cmake --build build --parallel succeeds with the VST3, LV2, and Standalone targets linking
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify anything under JUCE/ or change the pinned submodule commit
modify Source/PluginProcessor.*, Source/Telemetry/*, or any file under Source/GUI
change product identity values, target/format list, or C++ standard in CMakeLists.txt
add new third-party dependencies or any test framework other than juce::UnitTest
perform audio processing in the editor or read audio buffers outside TelemetryState
omit setLookAndFeel(nullptr) in the editor destructor

allowed: choose default editor size, resize limits, and nav bar height
forbidden: restructure the CMake target or add new targets
change plugin metadata or supported formats
modify page or telemetry class interfaces
